confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee, and beer estimates use Punta Cana cost-of-living averages near July 2026. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated at about 2.5 times local draft beer; accommodation estimates are less certain because resort-focused lodging and limited hostel coverage make basic-room prices harder to generalize.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Punta Cana's own local price data; no comparable city was used.
